basic_info.description: Located in the heart of the city, this updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse-style condo offers the perfect blend of style and comfort. Set within a boutique, 23-unit elevator building, this unit features abundant natural light, an open floor plan, and sleek, modern finishes.  The updated chef's kitchen is equipped with newer stainless-steel appliances and ample cabinets and countertops, making it ideal for cooking and entertaining.  Upstairs, you'll find two private primary suites, each with an ensuite bath and generous closet space. Recent updates include brand-new white-oak hardwood floors on the main level, updated kitchen and bathrooms hardware, and new paint. An in-unit storage and one-car garage parking with EV charging complete this unit.  Building amenities include video intercom for secure access, space for private storage in the garage, and a shared outdoor courtyard. Perfectly located near cafes, restaurants, Whole Foods, Polk Street shops and dining, Grace Cathedral, and Lafayette Park, with excellent transit connections and corporate shuttle access. With a Walk Score of 99 and Transit Score of 100, this home offers the very best of city living in a private retreat.
